status: DEPLOYED v2 2026-08-06 (accuracy improvement run; target 80-90% MET)

deploy_verify_v2.route: live predict_by_crop(okra), single-view (matches internal single-view 86.21%); internal 4-view TTA = 89.66%
deploy_verify_v2.existing_crops: papaya 95/95, bean 52/52, tea 40/40 routed correctly; 0/862 logit diffs, 0 top-1 changes (zero-regression spot check)

dataset.name: Okra DiseaseNet (Mendeley Data, DOI 10.17632/nh7zk4hv8z, v1)
dataset.critical_finding: The Mendeley distribution is HEAVILY duplicative: 1495 files contain only 293 unique images (identical bytes under multiple filenames). dHash near-dup groups exactly equal the MD5 duplicate groups, so after exact-MD5 dedup no additional visual leakage remains.
dataset.resolution: MIXED (104 distinct sizes, up to 6000x4000; readme claims 224x224 but files are high-res)

preparation.v1_balance: random undersample to smallest class (LCV=31), seed 42 -> Okra_Split (300 train/18 valid/18 test)
preparation.v2_balance: NONE (--full): all 293 unique images used; mild 1.51:1 imbalance handled by training -> Okra_Split_full
preparation.note: Using all unique images (v2) raised test accuracy from 72.2% to 89.7% (TTA) by ~1.6x-ing the training set. V1 balanced split retained as Okra_Split; v2 is Okra_Split_full.

training.approach: frozen EfficientNet-B0 backbone (1280-d from production ONNX), Linear(1280->6) head, only okra rows 146-151 trained; existing 146 rows byte-identical
training.v1_best_config: seed 7, wd 0.01, label_smoothing 0.2, Adam lr 1e-3 (balanced split) -> test 72.22%
training.v2_best_config: 3-seed weight-space ensemble (seeds 42,7,123), wd 0.01, label_smoothing 0.2, Adam lr 1e-3, early stop (full split) -> DEPLOYED

integration_pending_approval: Commit (local repo) only when the user explicitly requests it.
actions_taken: Downloaded Okra DiseaseNet (1495 files, 8.2GB) from Mendeley into dataset/okra/raw/
Trained candidate + exported ONNX + zero-regression verified
Did NOT modify production model, did NOT commit, did NOT push
recommendation: The 6-class okra module routes correctly and existing crops are 100% unaffected, but internal test accuracy (72.2%) is below the 80-90% target, driven by the approved dataset containing only 293 unique images. Recommend the user decide whether to (a) deploy as-is knowing the shortfall, (b) augment with a supplemental okra dataset (out of scope of the approved workflow), or (c) drop the crop.
